title: Reset the shared website and publish its Hello World baseline
steps: Pause and drain active work; retain a verified private recovery snapshot
Reset shared public proposals and activity while preserving financial records
Commit and build the fixed platform Hello World page without deployment credentials
Verify staging and production responses before recording the version-one platform release
expectedOutcomes: Previous public proposals, reviews and messages are absent from the fresh workspace
The isolated preview shows a real checked Hello World starting page with platform provenance
Historical spending records remain intact and retries cannot clear a new workspace
